## Description

Long currencies with higher short-term interest rates and short lower-rate currencies, optionally risk-weighted.

## Where it may fit

Stable risk appetite and persistent interest-rate differentials; vulnerable to sharp risk-off reversals.

## Vehicles

Currency hedge funds, global macro, FX forwards/futures.

## Required data

Spot and forward rates, policy rates, forward points, funding, volatility, costs and intervention/event data.

## Caveats

Carry is exposed to crash risk, funding changes and basis; quoted rate differential alone is insufficient.
